THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY.

This is NOT a solicitation, but market research to determine potential sources for Javelin+ Mobile Biometric Collection Kit for Schriever Space Force Base, CO, in accordance with the attached Javelin Salient Characteristics.
